name: manual_cec9b1
claim: Every backgrounded external CLI/agent dispatch (codex exec, kimi -p, an Agent/SendMessage subagent) needs an explicit 15-minute hard ceiling (Monitor with a kill -0 poll + force-kill on timeout), not just reliance on the run_in_background completion notification — a stalled process and a legitimately slow one look identical from outside until you check sustained CPU activity.

decisions.notes: A codex exec Eng-review dispatch for PR #205 ran unbounded past 19 minutes with near-zero CPU before a ceiling was added retroactively (2026-07-12). Codified as a default in orama-system's canonical shell-hygiene skill (bin/orama-system/skills/shell-hygiene/SKILL.md § 5), cross-linked from kimi-agent and gstack review-voice docs, so future sessions don't re-derive it.
